name: postulo
description: Cross-platform task runner (works in PowerShell/cmd). No root dependencies.

scripts.setup: node -e "require('fs').existsSync('.env')||require('fs').copyFileSync('.env.example','.env')" && cd backend && uv sync && cd ../frontend && npm install
scripts.dev:backend: cd backend && uv run uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8000
scripts.lint: cd backend && uv run ruff check . && uv run ruff format --check . && cd ../frontend && npm run lint
